result.reason: Although paragraph (b) states the preferred cap, carve-outs and payment-obligation treatment, the retained provisions still broadly disclaim Licensor liability except for direct damages caused by gross negligence or wilful misconduct. Those provisions undercut liability for confidentiality, data/security, indemnification, fraud and IP-infringement claims, so the required carve-outs are not effective. Further, making all of paragraph (a) mutual also mutualizes its sweeping IP and other rights disclaimer, rather than only the indirect/consequential-damages exclusion, creating conflict with the IP carve-out and altering more than necessary. The unexplained reordering of existing text, internal contradictions and existing drafting errors further reduce clarity and quality.
